name: tenant-stacksim
description: CES Tenant Stack Simulator (G-STACKSIM-1) - fakes a Microsoft GCC High tenant for Stamper/AO/EO integration testing

scripts.stacksim: npm run build && node bin/stacksim.mjs up
scripts.coverage:ao: npm run build && node bin/stacksim.mjs coverage-ao
scripts.demo: npm run build && node scripts/build-demo-scenario.mjs && node bin/stacksim.mjs scenario demo-dib-small && node bin/stacksim.mjs serve m365_azure --slug demo-dib-small
scripts.demo:reset: npm run build && node scripts/build-demo-scenario.mjs && node bin/stacksim.mjs scenario demo-dib-small
